selection.rationale: Freeze five matched sizes and 1000 independent records per point. Broad X pilot supports .035-.065 and preserves the preceding X grid. The 100-shot Z refinement places the crossing near .03-.035; .025-.04 centers seven rates around it, brackets size-order reversal and avoids the nearly saturated .045-.05 range. Six of seven Z rates match the preceding two-slice study. All 2220 pilot records are excluded from production estimates and fitting.
selection.analysis_note: All numerical fit routines and guard policy are frozen before production; input-validation and presentation code may finish independently. Existing inverse-size corrections, drop-smallest and narrowed-window checks remain mandatory.
selection.performance_refreeze_note: The original selection and all earlier outputs are archived under pre-optimization/. Only the implementation of exact binary matrix parity was optimized. The grid, seeds, sample counts, decoder settings, fit windows, bootstrap seeds and numerical policy are identical to the original frozen design. All pilots and production are rerun under the final source manifest; repeated streams are not pooled.
